queries.sql: SELECT "Account"."id" AS "Account_id", "Account"."email" AS "Account_email", "Account__Account_posts"."id" AS "Account__Account_posts_id", "Account__Account_posts"."title" AS "Account__Account_posts_title" FROM "account" "Account" LEFT JOIN "post" "Account__Account_posts" ON "Account__Account_posts"."author"="Account"."id" WHERE ((("Account"."id" >= $1 AND "Account"."id" < $2)))
